intro.title: Build Prometheus metrics endpoint
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple HTTP endpoint in Node.js that exposes Prometheus-style metrics. You will learn how to use the Node.js HTTP module to create a server that responds to requests with formatted metric data. The core concept involves handling HTTP requests and structuring responses with plain text content. By the end, you'll have a working endpoint that can be scraped by monitoring tools like Prometheus.
intro.usecase: Prometheus metrics endpoints are essential in production Node.js applications for monitoring system health and performance. Developers implement these endpoints to expose metrics like request rates, error counts, and response times, which are then visualized in dashboards like Grafana. This enables teams to detect anomalies, set up alerts, and make data-driven decisions to optimize application reliability and user experience.
